dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's the most frightening thing that has ever happened to you?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfraɪtənɪŋ ˈθɪŋ ðæt hæz ˈɛvər ˈhæpənd tə juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Probably the night I found a snake in my bathroom.
dialogue.reading: ˈprɑːbəbli ðə ˈnaɪt aɪ ˈfaʊnd ə ˈsneɪk ɪn maɪ ˈbæθruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I opened the door, and to my horror, there was a snake in the toilet!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ ˈoʊpənd ðə ˈdɔːr, ənd tə maɪ ˈhɔːrər, ðɛr wʌz ə ˈsneɪk ɪn ðə ˈtɔɪlət!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was terrified. I screamed and ran out of the room.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈtɛrəfaɪd. aɪ ˈskriːmd ənd ˈræn ˈaʊt əv ðə ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I called the emergency number. To my surprise, a rescue team came in ten minutes.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkɔːld ði ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi ˈnʌmbər. tə maɪ sərˈpraɪz, ə ˈrɛskjuː ˈtiːm ˈkeɪm ɪn ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow, that was quick. Were they shocked when they saw it?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ, ðæt wʌz ˈkwɪk. wɜːr ðeɪ ˈʃɑːkt wɛn ðeɪ ˈsɔː ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not at all! One of them picked it up with his hands. I was amazed.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ət ˈɔːl! ˈwʌn əv ðɛm ˈpɪkt ɪt ˈʌp wɪð hɪz ˈhændz. aɪ wʌz əˈmeɪzd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. To my relief, he said it wasn't dangerous. But I still check the toilet every night!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. tə maɪ rɪˈliːf, hiː ˈsɛd ɪt ˈwʌzənt ˈdeɪndʒərəs. bʌt aɪ ˈstɪl ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈtɔɪlət ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt!
